center.source: 01-RESEARCH.md 'Code Examples' worked example for the Orly-Ville/runway-3 area (48.7233N, 2.3794E), cross-checked against the English Wikipedia 'Orly Airport' infobox coordinate field (48°43'24"N 02°22'46"E → 48.7233, 2.3794 decimal). Used as the query center/radius origin, not the runway itself - the bbox below is the actual runway-3 filter. Checked 2026-08-04.

bbox.source: Computed (not looked up) from the confirmed runway-3 threshold coordinates in 'runway' below: extended roughly 2.5km beyond each threshold along the runway's own bearing (magnetic ~074/254) to include the on-approach and rollout segments, plus a small lateral margin. This box is tight enough to exclude the crossing 02/20 runway and most distant taxiway/apron holding areas, but is not perfectly exclusive of the nearby, non-parallel 06/24 runway, whose western end sits close to runway 3's western threshold - a known limitation to keep in mind when reading 'in bbox' counts. Checked 2026-08-04.

runway.source: OurAirports open aviation data, runways.csv (https://davidmegginson.github.io/ourairports-data/runways.csv), row with airport_ident=LFPO, le_ident=07 / he_ident=25, length_ft=10892 (=3320.0m exactly), le_latitude/le_longitude and he_latitude/he_longitude as recorded above. Cross-checked against the English Wikipedia 'Orly Airport' article infobox (r3_number=07/25, r3_length_m=3,320), which independently corroborates the exact 3320m length for this runway. Note: PROJECT.md's earlier text informally called this runway '08/26' with the same ~3,320m length; the confirmed ICAO heading-pair designator from both sources above is 07/25 (magnetic heading approx. 074deg/254deg). Because the length matches exactly across two independent sources and no other Orly runway has this length, 07/25 is treated as the confirmed identity for 'runway 3' rather than the earlier informal '08/26' label - this correction should be carried into any later document update per D-03. Checked 2026-08-04.
